note: Golden expectations derived from brewery-plant.spec.md (this folder) Section 8; the run-tests checker (.claude/skills/run-tests/check.py) consumes this file. Per-project copies live at Sites/<Name>/Tests/expected.json. Asserted on STABLE invariants read through the product over MCP, not on raw totals: the .dbsln is encrypted, built-in tags are hidden from the MCP tag count, and an upgrade adds the MCP user account. So the structural gate checks present-by-name domain tags, exact monitor and screen counts (stable), and a minimum user count. The domain UserTypes are confirmed at runtime via the members of a BrewLine instance (Tank, Pump, Valve). See KnowledgeBase/References/dbsln-format-note.md.
